key_gap: The AI matched every checkable number (p = 30.2 MPa, t = 22.6 mm, mass 69 kg, ballast ≈ 47 kg) and even converted the inherited 12 mm into a scaled cross-check (22.5 mm), but framed the flotation/ballast consequence out of scope in WHAT and reached it only via a REVIEW correction, and quantified uncertainty with a single ad hoc perturbation (±10% σ_allow → 20.6–25.0 mm was the human's, not the AI's, contribution).
learning_signal: On checkable derivation problems the style's edge is (a) model-validity bounds checked before use (t/r ≤ 0.1, not assumed), (b) converting inherited experience by scaling instead of copying (12 mm → 22.5 mm ≈ derived 22.6 mm — a free verification route), and (c) operational consequences of the artifact (floats? sinks? fits?) treated as first-class design outputs. The AI exhibited (a) and (b) but needed process prompting for (c) and produced thinner calibration.
suggested_improvement: Extend the WHAT-stage default frame for physical/engineering design tasks to include 'operational consequences of the artifact' (floats/sinks/fits/survives) as a mandatory output, and require ≥ 2 quantified perturbations of the dominant design assumption (here σ_allow) in the decision packet's uncertainty block instead of one ad hoc case.

key_gap: Pure first-principles reasoning breached a hard SLA: it refused to act without mechanism, discarded the 85%/60% base rates as unmeasured correlation, re-derived what the runbook already encoded, and delivered a certain root cause 27 minutes late (healthy at T = 47 vs 20-min deadline). The AI won by carrying the deadline into every alternative's arithmetic (P×time per step), using the base rates as priors with a recurrence-based falsification rule, and designing each restart as remedy-plus-probe, resolving at T = 12.
learning_signal: For time-boxed operational decisions, empirical base rates are evidence, not noise: 'understand before act' must be bounded by deadline arithmetic, a runbook is a prior to be updated rather than a shortcut to be re-derived, and action-as-probe (restart = remedy + diagnosis) is the correct synthesis of rigor and speed. The style's failure here was structural (time cost and prior-blindness), not a reasoning error.
suggested_improvement: Add a TIME-BOXED decision mode in META for deadline-bearing tasks: compute elapsed-time × success-probability per alternative before selection; require an explicit update/falsification rule (recurrence → next step) wired into HOW; and cap open-ended investigation at a deadline-safe budget with a defined fallback action (here: recur → rollback) — and treat provided empirical base rates as mandatory priors unless directly contradicted.
